claims.claim_text: The indexed Tully R Cornick Jr. has a confirmed match to the exact private identifier and exact name in the official Army merged file.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The indexed identifier selects the sole exact-name Army row, dated 12 February 1942 as a private; a squadron roster independently repeats the identifier, name, birth year and Nevada context.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Exact private identifier and exact indexed name establish the Army match; the independent squadron compilation corroborates multiple details.
claims.temporal_assessment: The records date Army entry and later squadron service but do not identify an OSS start, employer or Army-to-OSS sequence.
claims.match_notes: The full private identifier remains private. Later squadron service is identity context, not a pre-OSS affiliation.

claims.temporal_assessment: The source documents wartime mission context on 9 September 1944, not a pre-OSS employer or predecessor affiliation.
claims.match_notes: The alias is a documented search variant. The history is tentative, so Box 145 and cited NARA and SHD records remain controlling.

claims.claim_text: The indexed John P Corriera is a high-confidence match to an official Army row whose fixed-width identifier adds one leading zero.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The exact rare name and seven indexed identifier digits agree after one leading zero; the Army row's 1913 birth-year and Rhode Island context align with an official state veterans inventory.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The private identifier, rare exact name, middle initial, birth year, state and Army service align. The leading-zero formatting difference and 10 November 1945 Army-entry date prevent confirmed status without Box 145.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army record is dated after OSS dissolution and is used only for identity and enlisted-status context, not as pre-OSS occupation or affiliation evidence.
claims.match_notes: The full identifier is withheld. No occupation, employer, branch assignment or pre-OSS sequence is transferred from the late Army row.
